# build source

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:buildSource`](gmeow-buildSource.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/buildSource>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The source commit or repository that a build activity consumes. Non-functional: a build may consume multiple commits (monorepo) or a repository at a specific ref.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:BuildActivity`](../classes/gmeow-BuildActivity.md) -> [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md) | [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:buildSource`](gmeow-buildSource.md) from [`gmeow:BuildActivity`](../classes/gmeow-BuildActivity.md) to [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md) | [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
